purpose: Distinguish acquisition-history dependence from ordinary replay reconstruction error without changing any frozen PB3 threshold.

m0_sequential_history.description: Fresh process; exact PB2-C batch0 seed123 to completion, then batch1 seed124 prefix through t13.

m1_isolated_collector.description: Fresh process; directly run batch1 seed124 prefix through t13.

m2_build_state_restore.description: Fresh process; capture/reset build_state, then batch1 seed124 prefix through t13.

diagnostic_decision.confirmation_rule: Confirm only if every M0 repeat passes original PB3 alignment AND median M0 coordinate RMSE <= 0.5*median M1 coordinate RMSE AND median M0 rope max-abs <= 0.5*median M1 rope max-abs.
diagnostic_decision.if_not_confirmed: Proceed to PB3-R2 independent non-shortlist replay-floor calibration; do not modify PB3 thresholds.
